remarks: This impeccable 4th floor condo is located in the heart of vibrant downtown Stamford, only steps away from popular restaurants, shopping, entertainment and serene Mill River Park. Easy access to nearby Metro North and I-95 make this the perfect location for commuters too. From the entry, step into the charming dining room which leads to an upgraded kitchen with ample cabinetry, stainless appliances, gas stove and quartz countertops. The spacious, sun filled living room features a stunning window wall with oversized sliders opening onto a relaxing balcony. The entire residence is decorated in a tasteful palette of soothing neutral tones with richly detailed molding added for classic appeal. The bedroom wing offers a bright, airy primary bedroom with walk in closet and private bath with whirlpool bathtub and shower enhanced with limestone. The bright second bedroom located next to the hall bath with shower is just perfect as a guest room or study, in unit washer and dryer, too. Full service community amenities include: 24/7 concierge service, spa like indoor pool with dramatic skyline views and fitness center, recently renovated community club room with kitchen for social gatherings, roof top terrace and pet friendly green space area. Conveniently located and deeded garage space. Just move right in and get ready to enjoy a beautiful and carefree lifestyle! Agents see agent remarks regarding spec. assess.
